text:
Read your Google profile description like a stranger would.

"Cheapest electrician in Perth, call now for 20% off!"

Google's policy now keeps promos, pricing and calls to action out of the listing itself.

Try: "Family-owned electricians servicing Joondalup and the northern suburbs since 2012."

A plumber pays a bloke on Fiverr AUD$150 to get him onto page one of Google.

(Still waiting.)

Page one has no price tag. Google's own help page says you can't pay for a better local ranking.

What works takes months. A profile somebody looks after every week, and reviews from real customers.

If it works, it works.

If it's a trick, it stops working the day Google notices.

And Google never picks a quiet week to notice.

Build the thing that's still standing after the next update.
